newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says dividend depends on results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says dividend depends on results.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd chief executive Nick Stump said on Friday that restoration of the group's dividend to previous levels during 1996/97 depended on results.
"Restoration of dividend levels depends on the current year's outcome," Stump told a news conference.
MIM said earlier it would cut its final dividend to 1.25 cents a share for the second half of 1995/96 to June 30 from 2.5 cents a year earlier.
Stump said that while the company would have liked to lift the dividend, a huge capital programme precluded such a move.
"We have a huge capital programme ahead of us," Stump said.
"We can only hope that with improvements in the copper price a higher dividend will be possible'" he added.
Stump said MIM thought there might be some improvement in the copper price this year, but added "we do not know."
"We see gearing rising to 40 percent plus this year from the current 30 percent but falling quite quickly thereafter," executive general manager of finance said.
MIM earlier reported a net profit after abnormals of A$170.6 million and a net profit before abnormals of A$29.8 million versus A$38 million a year earlier.
